text:
alex: Quick sanity check — planning to cut release 0.22.0 next Tue. Need coordinated bumps across api, runtime, console, and sdk. Cutoff is EOD Mon (PST).

alex: Proposed minimal plan:
- runtime: tag/rc -> 0.22.0-rc1 (jon)
- api: pin compatible minor -> 0.22.0 (kai)
- console: update UI changelog + migration note (sara)
- sdk: release client 0.22.0 with deprecated flags (maria)

alex: Owners — can you confirm ETA? If any repo needs extra time, flag now so we can shift cutoff. @jon @maria @sara @kai

maria: I got SDK. Will open PR with bump + changelog by today, aim in by 18:00 PST. PR title like `sdk: bump 0.22.0` and include migration snippet.

jon: I can take runtime. Will create rc branch + run the quantized integration smoke. ETA: tomorrow morning. Need one Ops window for the sample perf run.

jon: branch I'll use: `bump/runtime/0.22-rc1`
```bash
git checkout -b bump/runtime/0.22-rc1
# update version in build.gradle
```

sara: Console ok — I'll add the changelog entry and small UI banner note about the config flag rename. Quick Q: do we change the route or keep alias? @kai?

kai: API contract stays backward compatible for this bump; keeping alias for one release. I'll run the schema diff and post results. Will also queue the smoke test against staging.

deploy-bot: changelog-lint: passed for `sdk` (PR #4123).

pr-ops: Please remember to add cross-repo checklist to the release doc:
- dependency matrix
- smoke test matrix (runtime x api x sdk)
- rollback commands

alex: Two small asks: 1) include migration snippet in sdk changelog (example of renamed flag). 2) whoever cuts runtime rc, please tag commit with `release/0.22.0-rc1` so our cut tooling can pick it up.

maria: Will include migration snippet. Sample line: `client.set_streaming(false) -> client.enable_streaming(false)` in the changelog.

jon: Will tag as requested. I might need a quick hand from infra if the quantized binary doesn't publish automatically. @pr-ops can you help coordinate the infra ticket?

pr-ops: Yep, I'll file infra ticket and ping infra on the ticket.

kai: Ran schema diff — no breaking changes. Staging smoke tests queued, should finish by EOD.

sara: Console PR draft up (WIP) — will add screenshot and changelog after maria's final line.

alex: Great. I'll lock cutoff to Mon 23:59 PST unless anyone yells. I'll post a final reminder Mon AM with a short checklist. Thanks all :thumbsup:
